whatsapp_text: Hi, I'd like to discuss a B2B e-commerce platform.
persona: Director of a medical supplies or equipment business selling to hospitals, dealers and clinics on account

sections.h2: What a healthcare B2B e-commerce platform does
paras: A healthcare B2B e-commerce platform lets hospitals, dealers and clinics buy from you on the terms they already have. Each account logs in to its own price tier, sees its credit limit and outstanding balance, reorders from past orders in bulk, and either pays on the platform or places the order against credit for settlement later.

The difference from a retail store is what happens behind the order. New buyers are onboarded as accounts with documents, GST details and an approved tier rather than signing up in a second. Orders do not sit in an inbox: they become sales orders, GST invoices and stock movements in Aura Business, so the warehouse and accounts work from the same record as the buyer.

It is built on Next.js and Supabase. The Medline Robotics storefront and distributor portal, with quotations, distributor ordering and UTR payment verification, is the shipped example of this pattern.

sections.eyebrow: Why a retail platform cannot do this
sections.h2: Your buyers are accounts, not shoppers.
sections.lead: Consumer e-commerce assumes one price, immediate payment and an anonymous customer. Healthcare B2B assumes none of those.

items.p: A government hospital on rate contract, a dealer on slab pricing and a small clinic cannot all see the same figure.
Buyers order against agreed terms. A platform that demands payment at checkout simply pushes them back to the phone.
A dealer account carries pricing you do not want public, so onboarding has to be an approval, not a sign-up form.
A monthly consumables order of sixty lines cannot be built by clicking Add to cart sixty times.
Someone retypes the order into billing, stock is adjusted late, and the buyer is told a different delivery date.

sections.h2: From onboarding to a settled order.

steps.p: A prospective dealer or hospital submits GST details, address and documents through the onboarding form.
Your team verifies the documents, approves the account and assigns its price tier and credit limit.
The buyer orders at their own prices, by search, by past order or by uploading a line list for bulk.
The platform shows the credit limit and outstanding balance, and flags an order that would exceed it for approval.
The order becomes a sales order, a GST invoice and a delivery challan, and stock moves against it.
Payment by transfer with a UTR submitted and verified, or against credit with the ageing tracked in receivables.

items.q: How is this different from your e-commerce development page?
items.a: The storefront page covers selling a catalogue with quote-to-order and payment verification. This page covers the account layer on top: tiered pricing, credit limits, onboarding and bulk ordering for buyers who purchase every month on terms.

items.q: Can buyers order against credit instead of paying?
items.a: Yes. Each account carries a credit limit and terms. The platform shows the outstanding balance, allows the order within the limit, and flags anything beyond it for your approval. Ageing is tracked in receivables.
When the platform is connected to Aura Business, the fulfilled order creates the stock movement, so the warehouse ledger and the site read the same quantities rather than two separate counts.

items.q: Can we onboard distributors through the platform?
items.a: Yes. A public application collects GST details, address and documents. Your team verifies and approves, then assigns the price tier, credit limit and territory before the account can see pricing.

items.q: What about buyers who still want a quotation?
items.a: Quotations sit alongside ordering. Capital equipment and negotiated lines go through the GST quotation flow and convert to an order, while consumables and spares are ordered directly at tier price.

items.q: How long does a B2B platform take to build?
items.a: Live in 30 working days where scope allows. Catalogue, accounts, tier pricing and ordering are the core. Credit checks, onboarding approval and Aura Business integration are scoped with you before work begins.
